4590.title: Plugin close commands are absent from desktop close arbitration
4590.rootCauseOneLine: Desktop close requests dispatch only desktop listeners; plugin SDK commands cannot participate, so an unclaimed request reaches the window-close fallback.
4590.proposedFix: Design a focus-aware experimental SDK close participant shared by renderer keyboard and desktop menu arbitration; not eligible for an automatic simple fix.
4590.caveats: Two clean boundary runs, not a full macOS Electron/native-keyboard reproduction. No real plugin view or renderer command provider was mounted.
